text: Gauss sums for the two-layer structure. Over \(\mathbb F_3\) the character sum of a quadratic form of rank \(\rho\) has modulus \(3^{-\rho/2}\), with its phase fixed by the discriminant. The bias of every killer term thus reduces to the joint distribution of the rank and discriminant of a quadratic-form pencil in \(\ell'\).
